title: a client that finds its stale bus draining uses it instead of spawning a loser
intention: When ensure_bus finds its local bus stale and the shutdown it sends is answered with draining, it uses that bus, which keeps serving through the drain, instead of spawning a second bus that loses bus.lock and raises. It notes the drained use in the client log.
why: From remote.py source: ensure_bus spawns after every _replace. While the old bus holds bus.lock the spawn exits EXIT_HELD, and ensure_bus raises 'no bus process answered' after 15 s. Once the bus drains its in-flight requests (sibling 1029d5146152, cast from the 2026-11-12 measured kill in idea 7306eaa10907), every client arriving during the drain would fail that way unless this changes.
traces_to: Law 7 (a stale bus served on purpose is said in the log, not silent) and Akien's bus intention: a wake takes at most 60 s (outline 5.5.3.9).
how: _replace returns the shutdown reply and returns at once on draining. ensure_bus re-checks _answers on a draining reply, notes it, and returns the old bus's stats; otherwise the path is unchanged. Red-first proof with a fake AF_UNIX bus in a scratch home and _spawn recorded.

clauses.claim: when a stale bus answers shutdown with draining, ensure_bus returns that bus's stats and spawns nothing
when the shutdown reply carries no draining, ensure_bus waits for the old bus to stop answering and then spawns, as before
a drained use writes one note line to the client log naming the draining count

decisions.text: D1: _replace returns the shutdown reply (None when the exchange raised) and returns at once when it carries draining. ensure_bus's local branch, on a draining reply, re-asks _answers; when that is ok it calls _note(...draining n...) and returns its json. Otherwise it falls through to the spawn path unchanged.

D2: a red-first proof, one tooth per clause: a fake AF_UNIX bus served on a thread at a scratch home's bus.sock, remote._spawn and remote._beside_the_manager monkeypatched, remote._LOG at a scratch file, CAIRN_BUS_HOME unset for the call.

measured.saw: ensure_bus spawns after every _replace; a spawn beside a held bus.lock exits EXIT_HELD, and ensure_bus raises after _START_WAIT_S = 15 s
measured.how: read cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py ensure_bus and _replace, and server.serve's claim/EXIT_HELD path
